acceptanceCriteria: The golden corpus yields at least one marker and the golden pack covers blob shards; a test proves a marker-only output change moves the output digest.
script/analyzer-schema.sh routes its go test through the host semaphore when one exists, with a test.
body: Residual from the contextindex-snapshot-1021u lane (PR #1514, V1-2289 / IDX-SNAP-V0-107). TestAnalyzerSchemaOutput pins the digest of the pack built from a fixed golden corpus, and script/analyzer-schema.sh bump keeps the base number when that digest is unchanged. Gaps: (1) the golden corpus produces no markers, so an output change that only affects markers does not move the digest and a needed bump is skipped; (2) blob shards (IDX-SNAP-V0-016) are not in the golden pack; (3) the script's default bump command runs go test directly, not through heavy.sh, so concurrent lanes thrash the host (cf. V1-1628).
title: analyzer-schema output digest misses markers and blob shards; script bump runs go test outside the host semaphore
